name: Sump-Spunk

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The sump-spunk makes two Slam attacks.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Caustic Spasm
Bonus Actions.text: One creature within 5 feet that hit the sump-spunk with an attack roll since the end of the sump-spunk's last turn takes 10 (3d6) Poison damage.
Bonus Actions.gmQuote: a creature that poisons everything it touches including itself

Traits.name: Shared Caustic Bloom
Traits.text: When the sump-spunk is touched by or struck with a melee attack from any creature within 5 feet of it, including itself, the caustic film seeps onto the attacker; the sump-spunk's own caustic film cannot harm the sump-spunk itself.

Traits.name: Caustic Film
Traits.text: A creature that touches the sump-spunk or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
Traits.gmQuote: a creature that poisons everything it touches
Traits.expresses: caustic touch that poisons whatever it contacts, itself included

lore: Woken from a ruptured alchemical sump where dumped venoms pooled together, it lumbers the drainage tunnels trying to touch something, anything, and smear itself whole again.

generation.userConcept: a creature that poisons everything it touches, including itself
generation.cite: composition after Hill Giant (CR 5) — two of the same swing, thrown rock

monsterDescription: a creature that poisons everything it touches, including itself
